description: This file defines the class NoCsrfDefenseStrategy which implements the interface ICsrfDefenseStrategy. It provides a CSRF defense strategy that effectively disables CSRF protections, likely for testing or specific use cases within the security module of the project.

classes.name: NoCsrfDefenseStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class implementing ICsrfDefenseStrategy that disables CSRF token generation and validation, possibly for testing purposes.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no CSRF token is generated.

methods.name: maxSubFolderInRequestUrlForTokenMapLookup
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating no subfolder depth is used for token map lookup.

methods.name: modifySecurityCsrfToken
methods.description: Always returns false, indicating the CSRF token modification does not occur.

methods.name: keepTokenAfterUse
methods.description: Returns false, meaning tokens are not kept after use.

methods.name: invalidTokenResponse
methods.description: Empty method, no action taken for invalid token responses.
